opening.argument: OneCoin is presented as a paid route into mining, with packages priced from 130€ up to 50030€ and an online process described as joining mining “through a click of a button over the internet.” The pitch then attaches striking projected gains to named packages: the Tycoon Trader is said to give somewhere between €230K and €475K, and the Pro-Trader €19K to €39K. A trading-strategy table likewise lists mining pools and profit ranges. These are not neutral observations about cryptocurrency; package payments are tied to mining income and token appreciation as an opportunity to participate. The appeal closes by invoking “your own and your family's future,” encouraging viewers to join. The evidence establishes a direct solicitation built around paid mining packages and extraordinary financial projections, without establishing that those projected gains were actually received.
